name: Spontaneous Summon Fey
body:
Instead of summoning natural allies, you can instead cast summon fey.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks, ability to spontaneously cast summon nature’s ally spells.

Benefit(s): You can “lose” a prepared spell in order to cast any summon fey spell (see below) of the same level or lower, instead of casting a summon nature’s ally spell as you normally would. For the purpose of this feat only, the summon fey spells of the appropriate spell levels count as being on your spell list at the same spell level as for a druid, if they were not already on your spell list.
